description: Search open tech jobs by keywords, place, skills, level, work type, visa sponsorship, pay and posting date. Returns 20 jobs a page, newest first, or the best title matches first when there are keywords. Each job has `url` (its CareerHolo page) and `apply_url` (the company's own page).

level.description: Seniority: junior includes interns, senior includes leads

location.description: A city, state or country, e.g. "Berlin", "Texas", "Canada", or "Remote"

min_salary_usd.description: Stated pay of at least this, US dollars a year

page.description: Which page of results: 20 jobs a page, up to page 50

posted_within.description: First seen within this many days

query.description: Keywords: a role, skill or company, e.g. "data engineer" or "rust"

remote_from.description: Remote jobs open to people in this region

salary_stated.description: Only jobs that state their pay

skills.description: Skills every job must ask for, e.g. ["Python", "AWS"]

sort.description: Default: best title matches first when there are keywords

visa_sponsorship.description: Only jobs that say they sponsor a visa

name: search_jobs
title: Search tech jobs
